import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True, DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField', USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()
from django.db import connection, models
from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment
setup_test_environment()
connection.creation.setup_test_database()
from django.db.models import JSONField
class M(models.Model):
    value = JSONField(null=True)
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'auth'
with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(M)
M.objects.bulk_create([
    M(value={'c': 14}), M(value={'c': 15}), M(value={'c': 'x'}), M(value={'a': 1}),
])
print('exact  :', M.objects.filter(value__c=14).count())
print('in     :', M.objects.filter(value__c__in=[14]).count())
print('in 2   :', M.objects.filter(value__c__in=[14, 15]).count())
print('in str :', M.objects.filter(value__c__in=['x']).count())
print('in miss:', M.objects.filter(value__c__in=[99]).count())
print('SQL    :', str(M.objects.filter(value__c__in=[14]).query))
EOF
